meta.historicBasis: A real pre-pandemic high-service benchmark, not a proven all-time maximum or a best-of-every-line composite.
meta.frequencyMethod: Median of positive, consecutive first-boardable-stop departure gaps, separately by direction and then pooled, whose midpoint falls from 10:00 to 14:00. At least two departures within the window in a direction are required. Both directions are shown in details.
